msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buen día! ¡Qué chévere plan para las siete! Sí, pueden combinar buceo certificado, minicurso y snorkel en la misma salida; el snorkel se hace en una zona distinta a la de buceo.

Te dejo a continuación los precios por persona saliendo desde Cartagena. Para el grupo aplica un 10% adicional al descuento online en buceo recreativo, minicurso y snorkel. Deben solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar; no se aplica automáticamente. El precio final con el descuento se confirma al reservar.

Como son de Bogotá, los valores están en COP.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Quieres que te ayude a continuar con la reserva?

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Snorkeling in the Rosario Islands is a lovely way to spend your day. The Cartagena tour departs from Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m., so it would be very tight with your 5:00 p.m. all-aboard time. The departure time is fixed, and the tour can’t be shortened.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Solo yo. ¿A qué hora me recogerían en el Cocoliso y tengo que llevar algo? Gracias.
reply:
La recogida en Cocoliso es entre las 9:30 y las 9:45; la lancha te lleva a nuestra base y regresas al hotel hacia las 12:00–13:00.

Lleva tu carné de buceo, bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo está incluido. Para el seguro, completa el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación. 🌊

También necesitas:
• Estar listo a las 9:30 en tu hotel
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

¿Han pasado *más de 2 años* desde tu última inmersión?

msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon! You can fly from **7:00 a.m. on Thursday** after a daytime refresher on Wednesday, so your **10:00 p.m. flight meets the 18-hour waiting period**. The wait is counted from your last dive, not from your return to Cartagena.

Since you’re certified but haven’t dived for three years, I’d recommend a **refresher**. From Cartagena, it’s booked as the Dive Mini Course; the refresher includes a daytime dive and ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m. You’d return to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. Wednesday. The meeting point is **Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.**

The booking system closes at **4:30 p.m. the day before**, so Wednesday’s booking window has already closed. You can book for the next available date here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pick-up in Getsemaní. Please make your own way to **Muelle de la Bodeguita**; the meeting point is at **8:00 a.m.**, at entrance 3—just ask for Diving Planet. It’s about five minutes from the historic center. Ground transport to the dock isn’t included.

Please bring your **Open Water certification card**; you can also show a photo of it on the day. For the refresher, you’ll need to complete the **course medical form**: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. There’s no theory to complete beforehand; the instructor reviews it with you on the day. You’ll also need the insurance form from your booking confirmation email.

You'll also need:
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

The *refresher* is an instructor-led review before diving again: it is booked as the *Dive Mini Course* and costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. It uses the course medical form (even for certified divers; the link comes with the booking). Are you interested?

msg: Buenas tardes. Somos 6 amigos de Bogotá, todos certificados, y queremos hacer dos días de buceo saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Tienen descuento de grupo? Dos de nosotros llevamos nuestro equipo completo: ¿hay descuento por eso y se suma al de grupo?
reply:

¡Qué buen plan para disfrutar dos días de buceo en las Islas del Rosario! Para dos días, pueden elegir entre el paquete de **4 inmersiones diurnas** o el de **5 inmersiones, que incluye una nocturna**.

Sí, por ser 6, aplica el **10% de descuento para grupos de 5 o más**, además del **10% online**. Hay que solicitar el descuento de grupo al equipo **antes de pagar**; no se aplica automáticamente.

Quienes lleven el equipo completo pueden acceder al **5% por equipo propio**, pero ese descuento **no se suma al de grupo**: cada uno se combina solo con el descuento online. Para solicitarlo, también hay que contactar al equipo antes de pagar.

Como son de Bogotá, el precio es en COP.

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

reply:
Sí, pueden hacer dos salidas de un día: cada una es ida y vuelta desde Cartagena, así que pueden dormir allí entre ambas. Cada salida incluye 2 inmersiones y el regreso llega aproximadamente a las 4:15 p. m.

No puedo calcular un precio final con ese descuento; deben pedir que lo apliquen antes de pagar. El equipo completo incluye regulador, chaleco, traje, máscara y aletas, entre otros elementos.

Así que les conviene comparar ambas opciones con el equipo antes de pagar; el equipo de buceo ya está incluido en la salida.

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas
_Son 2 salidas de un día: se reserva una por día._

msg: Buenas tardes. Mi esposa y yo venimos de Medellín a Cartagena de luna de miel y nos gustaría probar el buceo. Nunca lo hemos hecho y nos da un poquito de nervios. ¿Cuánto cuesta y qué incluye? Nos estamos quedando en Bocagrande.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué chévere celebrar la luna de miel con una experiencia en el mar! Es normal sentir un poquito de nervios al principio: el minicurso está pensado para quienes nunca han buceado e incluye entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor PADI.

Incluye entrada al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro obligatorio de buceo, lancha de ida y regreso entre Cartagena y las Islas del Rosario, equipo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. No incluye el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos, propinas ni comida adicional.

El encuentro es a las **8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita**; desde Bocagrande tendrían que llegar por su cuenta. El regreso a Cartagena es a las **3:00 p. m.**, con llegada estimada a las **4:15 p. m.** El minicurso es una experiencia de iniciación, no una certificación.

También pueden elegir snorkel si prefieren empezar en la superficie: incluye equipo, dos salidas guiadas, lancha, almuerzo, seguro y entrada al parque. Te dejo los precios a continuación.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

Para una primera vez te recomiendo el *minicurso*: teoría, práctica en aguas tranquilas y una inmersión en el mar con instructor, sin necesidad de experiencia. Si lo que buscas es certificarte, está el *curso PADI Open Water*. ¿Te animas con el minicurso? 🤿

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
reply:
El minicurso llega hasta **12 metros**; lo habitual es bucear entre **5 y 12 metros**, según el punto elegido.

También necesitas:
• No hay teoría que hacer antes: se hace allí, el mismo día, con el instructor.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 12 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

No tengo confirmada la exigencia específica sobre qué tan bien hay que nadar. Como tu esposa tiene poca confianza en el agua, es importante que lo revise un asesor antes de reservar; no puedo asegurarle que pueda realizar la actividad.

🤿 *Minicurso de Buceo*
💰 *655.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

msg: Hola, ¿cómo andan? Soy Tomás, de Rosario, Argentina. Tengo el Advanced, unas 30 inmersiones, la última en marzo en Puerto Madryn. Viajo con todo mi equipo: regulador, chaleco, traje, máscara y aletas. ¿Me hacen algún descuento por llevar lo mío? Me gustaría salir dos días desde Cartagena a fin de mes.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Tomás! ¡Qué bacano que quieras bucear dos días en las Islas del Rosario! Sí: por llevar el equipo completo tienes un 5% de descuento en buceo recreativo. También aplica el 10% de descuento online; el descuento por equipo propio se suma al online. Para aplicarlo, hay que gestionarlo con un asesor antes de pagar.

Desde Cartagena, para dos días tienes estas opciones:
- **4 inmersiones diurnas:** 351 USD normal o 316 USD online; 1.282.000 COP normal o 1.154.000 COP online.
- **5 inmersiones, incluida una nocturna:** 436 USD normal o 392 USD online; 1.587.000 COP normal o 1.429.000 COP online.

Ambos planes requieren dormir en las islas; el alojamiento no está incluido. El de 4 inmersiones incluye almuerzo el primer día. El de 5 también incluye almuerzo solo el primer día. Como no tienen link de reserva, ¿quieres que te pase con un asesor para gestionar el descuento y la reserva?

msg: Dale, gracias. El tema es que ya tengo el hotel pagado en el centro de Cartagena, no quiero dormir en las islas. ¿No puedo salir un día, volver a Cartagena y salir de nuevo al día siguiente? ¿Cuánto sería así? Sería el 27 y el 28 de noviembre.
reply:
Para el paquete de 4 inmersiones en dos días no se puede volver a Cartagena entre jornadas: hay que alojarse en las islas al menos la noche del primer día. El hotel no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el alojamiento.

Si prefieres dormir en Cartagena, puedes hacer una salida de 2 inmersiones cada día, con regreso a Cartagena el mismo día. Cada salida cuesta **197 USD normal o 178 USD online**. La salida es a las 8:00 a. m. desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita y la lancha regresa a las 3:00 p. m. (llegada aproximada a las 4:15 p. m.).

Te paso con un asesor del equipo de Diving Planet.
Enseguida se pone en contacto contigo. ¡Gracias! :)

msg: Good call on asking: one of the certified guys, Mike, last dived about three years ago. The other two dived last summer. No beers, got it. So what does Mike need to do? And who do I talk to on your team to get the group discount before we pay?
reply:
Since Mike last dived about three years ago, a refresher is normally required before he joins the certified dive trip. It’s a pool session and one dive with an instructor, and it takes its own day, so he can’t do the refresher and the dive trip on the same day. If he has already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts. Very experienced divers with 500+ dives or Dive Master level can be reviewed by a team advisor.

For your one-day plan, Mike would need to arrange the refresher on a different day from the group’s dive trip. He’ll need to bring his certification card; gear is included. The refresher price from Cartagena is **183 USD online**.

To request the group discount, ask a team advisor to apply it **before anyone pays**. The 10% group discount applies to recreational diving and mini-courses and stacks with the 10% online discount, for 20% total when booking online. It isn’t automatic and can’t be refunded after payment. I can connect you with a team advisor.

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying

Keep in mind that the mini-course is a one-day introduction and does not certify you; to get certified there is the Open Water course (2 days, with a night on the islands).

The *refresher* is an instructor-led review before diving again: it is booked as the *Dive Mini Course* and costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. It uses the course medical form (even for certified divers; the link comes with the booking). Are you interested?

msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. I am a PADI Advanced diver with about 80 dives, my last dive was in September in Egypt. How does it work when I am already on the island: do you pick me up at the hotel, and what does it cost? I would like to dive on two of the days.
reply:
Hi, Anna! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon, Anna! Diving on two days from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the reefs, and your Advanced certification qualifies you for the certified-diving plans.

Yes—San Pedro de Majagua is one of our base hotels, so pick-up and return by boat are included. For the two-day, four-daytime-dive package, pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. each day, and you return to the hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Lunch isn’t included for island-based plans.

There are several two-day options: four daytime dives, four dives including a night dive, or five dives including a night dive. I’m leaving the prices below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like to book one of these options?

msg: Yes, the 4-dive package with daytime dives sounds right, on November 22 and 23. My flight home leaves Cartagena on November 24 at 16:00. Is this safe after diving? And could I go with your boat from the island to Cartagena that morning, or do I need to arrange this myself? I also have one large suitcase.
reply:
You need to wait at least **18 hours after your last dive before flying**. If your final daytime dive is on November 23 and ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., your November 24 flight at 4:00 p.m. is more than 18 hours later.

Pick-up from San Pedro de Majagua is included, and the daytime dives return you to the hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m. The package does **not** include transport back to Cartagena on November 24. Returning on a different day can be arranged by the team, subject to boat space, so you’ll need to confirm that with a team advisor.

I don’t have confirmed information about transporting a large suitcase on that boat, so please ask the advisor to confirm both the return transfer and luggage arrangements.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Buenas noches. Le escribe Ernesto, de Guadalajara, México. Tengo 58 años y soy buzo certificado Open Water desde hace muchos años, aunque mi última inmersión fue hace unos cinco años en Cozumel. Voy a Cartagena con mi esposa a principios de diciembre. Ella no bucea. ¿Puede acompañarme en la lancha? ¿Qué podría hacer ella mientras yo estoy abajo y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Ernesto. ¡Qué chévere que vengan a conocer las Islas del Rosario! Sí, tu esposa puede acompañarte en la lancha como acompañante. Puede quedarse en la isla, en nuestra base, mientras tú buceas; ese plan es para quien no bucea ni hace snorkel.

Desde Cartagena cuesta **80 USD online** o **89 USD precio normal**. Incluye lancha de ida y vuelta, almuerzo, seguro y entrada al Parque Nacional Natural. No incluye alojamiento.

Como llevas unos cinco años sin bucear, el catálogo recomienda el **Refresher**, que se reserva como Minicurso de Buceo.

Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente hace falta un refresh antes de la salida; si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh.

¿Quieres que te comparta el enlace para revisar esa opción y el de la salida de dos inmersiones?

msg: Hiya! I'm Priya, a British backpacker on a tight budget, currently in Santa Marta and heading to Cartagena next week. I've got three free days, November 17 to 19, and I've always wanted to get my diving certification. Is that doable in three days, and what's the cheapest way of doing it? I've got a hostel in Getsemaní booked already.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That’s a lovely goal, Priya! Yes, you can complete the PADI Open Water certification within your three free days: the course itself takes two days, with online theory beforehand. The course requires at least one overnight stay on the Rosario Islands, and your Getsemaní hostel won’t replace that island stay. Accommodation there isn’t included and must be booked directly with a hotel.

I’m leaving the course price below. The online price is the cheapest listed option.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• PADI Basic Course (Open Water): 693 USD · 770 USD

Would you like the booking link for the Open Water course?

msg: Brilliant. How long does the online theory take, and when do I get access to it? I'd have about a week to do it. Also, I need somewhere cheap to sleep on the island for that one night: do you know a budget option? And would I save anything by going to the island the day before and starting from there?
reply:
The Open Water eLearning takes about **10–12 hours** and must be completed before the practical sessions, so a week should give you time to work through it. The course includes online theory, but I don’t have the exact timing for when access is issued.

Accommodation isn’t included, and I don’t have hotel prices to identify the cheapest option. You can book directly with hotels on Isla Grande; options near our base include Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao, as well as San Pedro de Majagua and Cocoliso.

The island-based price excludes transport from Cartagena, so going the day before would mean arranging and paying for your own trip to the islands and accommodation. The course still requires an overnight stay on the islands during the course.

msg: Just me. Okay, I'll start from Cartagena then. What should I bring with me for the two days? I only have my big backpack, can I take it on the boat or leave it somewhere? I'd also love to bring my GoPro. And can I pay in cash when I arrive? My UK card charges me a fee abroad.
reply:
For the two days, bring a swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving equipment is included for the course’s practical sessions. You can bring one backpack or bag on the boat; if it’s a suitcase, it needs to be arranged with the team, or you can leave it at our Cartagena office. There are lockers at our island base for smaller belongings while you dive.

You can bring your GoPro, but underwater photos and videos aren’t included in the course.

As an international guest, payment is 100% by card through the online booking link; cash payment on arrival isn’t available. The online price includes a 10% discount, applied automatically. Your UK card may charge its own foreign-transaction fee.

One important timing note: the Open Water course requires at least one night on the Rosario Islands, and you must wait at least 18 hours after diving before flying.

🤿 *PADI Basic Course (Open Water)*
💰 *693 USD* per person (online rate)
📚 PADI course: dates, sessions and details are arranged with you.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: Okay, thanks. So who can tell me about the GoPro? I'd really like to film my first dives, it's kind of the whole point for me. And is storing my backpack at your office free? Last thing: I've got a flight to Medellín on the 19th at 9 in the morning, is that fine if I finish the course on the 18th?
reply:
You can bring your GoPro on the dives at your own risk. We don’t rent cameras, and underwater photos or videos aren’t included in the course. An instructor may take photos or videos as a voluntary gesture, but that isn’t guaranteed—so you should plan to use your own camera if filming is essential.

You can bring one backpack on the boat, so you shouldn’t need to store it at our Cartagena office. I don’t have the office-storage fee handy.

For a daytime final dive on November 18, you can fly from **7:00 a.m. on November 19**. Your 9:00 a.m. flight meets the 18-hour minimum, provided your last dive finishes by around 1:00 p.m. on the 18th. The course’s return boat is estimated to reach Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. on day two.

msg: ¿Me tocaría hacer algún repaso antes? ¿En qué consiste y cuánto cuesta en pesos?
reply:
Sí. Como llevas unos 4 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un repaso antes de volver al agua. El refresher es el Minicurso de Buceo: incluye práctica en piscina y una inmersión con instructor, y ocupa un día completo; ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Como estarás varios días, puedes hacer el repaso el primer día y bucear los siguientes.

No hay teoría que debas hacer antes; la ves allí con el instructor.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Ser buzo certificado y presentar tu carnet

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

¿Para cuántas personas sería: solo para ti o van más? 😊

msg: Me alojo en el centro histórico. ¿A qué hora y dónde hay que estar, y qué incluye el precio?
reply:
El punto de encuentro es a las *8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita*, a unos 5 minutos del centro histórico. Debes llegar por tu cuenta; el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle no está incluido. El regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m., con llegada estimada a las 4:15 p. m.

Como llevas unos 4 años sin bucear, el plan indicado es el *refresher (Minicurso de Buceo)*. Incluye:

- Entrada al Parque Nacional Natural y seguro obligatorio de buceo.
- Lancha rápida de ida y vuelta entre Cartagena y las islas.
- Entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor PADI.
- Equipo de buceo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.

El refresher cuesta *655.000 COP online* o *727.000 COP a precio normal*. No incluye transporte terrestre al muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas ni comida adicional al almuerzo.

También incluye:
• 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado

¿Para cuántas personas sería: solo para ti o van más? 😊

msg: Hi, I'm a German traveler in Cartagena and I've never dived. I'd like to get my Open Water certification. How long does the course take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Open Water course takes **2 days**. It’s a great way to start diving and earn your certification to dive down to 18 m.

From Cartagena, Day 1 starts at 8:00 a.m. at Muelle de la Bodeguita and includes pool practice and two dives. You’ll stay overnight on the islands (accommodation isn’t included). Day 2 includes another pool session and two final dives, with the boat returning to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. The course also has **online PADI eLearning theory before the in-water sessions**.

Would you like the course price and booking link?

msg: ¿Ella puede hacer algo en el agua? ¿Y necesitaría algún permiso médico?
reply:
Sí, puede hacer snorkel en superficie, con el visto bueno de su médico. Durante el embarazo no se recomienda bucear con botella, ni hacer minicurso, salidas de buceo o cursos.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.

¿Te animas con la *salida de 2 inmersiones*, un *paquete de varios días* o un *curso avanzado*? 🌊

El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. msg: Do I need a refresher since it's been so long? And how do I book?
reply:
Since it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. With about 30 dives, you don’t meet the 500+ dives threshold for the team review. If you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another centre, that counts. The refresher takes a full day, so you can’t do the 2-dive trip on the same day.

You can book the refresher online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en  
The online booking includes a 10% discount. The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you can still book online for the next available day.

The refresher includes pool practice and one reef dive with an instructor. There’s no theory to do beforehand. You’ll need to complete the course medical form (in Spanish): https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol, and bring your certification card.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

And how many people should I plan for? 😊

msg: ¿Nos recogen en Barú? ¿Dónde y a qué hora tendríamos que estar?

msg: Mi madre es vegetariana y tiene 68 años. ¿Hay almuerzo para ella y algún problema por la edad? ¿Se puede llevar una maleta o bebidas alcohólicas?
reply:
Sí, hay almuerzo vegetariano: arroz con vegetales. Y para el snorkel no hay problema por la edad; la edad mínima es 6 años y no se indica una edad máxima.

En la lancha pueden llevar una mochila o un bolso por persona. Si necesitan llevar una maleta, hay que coordinarlo con un asesor; también pueden dejarla guardada en la oficina de Cartagena.

No se permite llevar ni consumir bebidas alcohólicas en la lancha ni durante la actividad.

msg: We'd like a day with 2 dives next Friday. What's the deadline to book, and how do we pay?
reply:
For the regular certified 2-dive trip from Cartagena, the online price is **USD 178 per person**, with the 10% online discount applied automatically. It includes the boat, diving gear, lunch, and two guided dives, with a same-day return.

To go next Friday, book through this link **before 4:30 p.m. on Thursday**; the website closes bookings for the following day at that time: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

As international guests, you pay 100% by card on the website. If the online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer payment link while keeping the online discount.

In our *DIVE TO HEAL* program (adaptive diving), the price and logistics are arranged individually based on the activity and each person's needs — so it isn't a fixed website rate; an advisor sets it after evaluating your case, so the experience is safe and tailored to you. 🤿

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like me to connect you with an advisor for all the details? 😊

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).

- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.

msg: Un detalle: mi esposo buceó por última vez en abril de 2022 y yo en enero de este año, en Capurganá. ¿Eso cambia algo para él?
reply:
Sí, para tu esposo cambia: como su última inmersión fue en abril de 2022, ya pasaron más de 2 años y normalmente necesita hacer un *refresh* antes de volver a bucear. El refresh es el minicurso, con práctica en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor, y ocupa un día completo; como van varios días, podría hacerlo el primer día y bucear el siguiente.

Tú, que buceaste en enero de este año, no necesitarías refresh por tiempo sin bucear.

También necesitas:
• Ser buzo certificado y presentar tu carnet
• Con este plan debes alojarte 1 noche en las Islas del Rosario (hotel no incluido)
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Para quien aún no ha elegido te recomiendo estas opciones. ¿Cuál le apetece más? 🐠
• *Minicurso de buceo* — Primera vez bajo el agua con instructor: entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión real. Sin experiencia previa.
• *Curso Open Water* — Curso de certificación inicial: habilita para bucear de forma autónoma hasta 18 m.
• *Snorkel* — Para disfrutar el arrecife desde la superficie, con máscara y aletas. Ideal en familia.
• *Buceo certificado* — Inmersiones guiadas para buzos ya certificados; para explorar el arrecife a profundidad.
• *Ir de acompañante* — Viene en la lancha y disfruta el día con el grupo, sin meterse al agua.

msg: My husband is a certified Advanced diver (his last dive was in Cozumel this past March). Our daughter is 11 and has never tried scuba, and our son is 6. I don't dive. What could each of us do?
reply:
What a great family plan! 🌊 You're staying right at Cocoliso, one of our base hotels on Isla Grande, so pick-up is confirmed and included for you.

• *Your daughter* (11, never tried scuba): the *Dive Mini Course* (already on the islands) is perfect — no experience needed, from age 10, and it's a gentle first taste of diving.

• *Your son* (6): he can join the *Snorkeling Tour* (already on the islands) — minimum age 6, so he's just right for it.

• *You* (not diving): you can come along as a *Companion* — you ride the boat with the group, no diving or snorkeling.

All of these are already-on-the-islands options, so no need to travel to Cartagena. Minors need to be accompanied by a parent or responsible relative, which works out perfectly here. 🐠

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

msg: Great, thanks. So the plan would be: my husband diving, our 11-year-old trying scuba for the first time, and me and our 6-year-old snorkeling, all on December 3 from Hotel Cocoliso. We're US citizens. How do we book and pay?
reply:
That sounds like a lovely family plan! Since you’re already at Hotel Cocoliso, pickup is included. Your 11-year-old can try the Dive Mini Course, and your 6-year-old can snorkel. Your husband can join the certified dives if he holds an Open Water certification.

For December 3, book online before 4:30 p.m. on December 2. As US citizens, you’ll pay in USD by card on the website. Payment is recorded right away, then the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer link.

The online booking links are:
• Dive Mini Course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en
• Snorkeling Tour: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/snorkeling-already-on-the-island/25?language=en

The certified diving plan has no online booking link, so a team advisor needs to arrange that part.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

For the one who hasn't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Certified diving* — Guided dives for already-certified divers; explore the reef at depth.
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Open Water course* — Entry certification course: qualifies you to dive independently down to 18 m.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.

msg: Otra duda: el domingo 29 cojo un avión de Cartagena a Bogotá a las 6:30 de la mañana para enlazar con Madrid. ¿Hay algún problema por bucear el sábado?
reply:
Para buceo recreativo, debes esperar al menos 18 horas desde tu última inmersión antes de volar. Si la última inmersión del sábado es diurna, termina hacia las 12:00–1:00 p. m., así que podrías volar desde las 7:00 a. m. del domingo. Tu vuelo de las 6:30 a. m. sale media hora antes de ese margen, así que no alcanza.

Además, el paquete incluye una inmersión nocturna. Si esa es tu última inmersión, las 18 horas se cuentan desde que termine, por lo que el vuelo del domingo tampoco sería compatible.

NADA

msg: ¿Cómo es el curso Open Water con ustedes? ¿Cuántos días dura, hay que estudiar algo antes y se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día?
reply:
¡Qué chévere que quieran certificarse! El Open Water es el curso inicial completo de buceo recreativo y dura **2 días**. Incluye teoría, entrenamiento en piscina y **4 inmersiones en aguas abiertas**; al terminar, obtienen una certificación para bucear hasta **18 metros**.

Antes de empezar la parte práctica, deben completar la teoría en **PADI eLearning**, que toma aproximadamente **10 a 12 horas**.

No se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día: deben alojarse **al menos una noche en las islas**, después del primer día. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel. Desde Cartagena, el primer día salen a las 8:00 a. m. desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita; el segundo día regresan a Cartagena en la lancha de las 3:00 p. m. (llegada aproximada a las 4:15 p. m.).

El precio por persona es **693 USD online** o **770 USD normal**.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

msg: Bárbaro. Somos dos argentinos y queremos el curso Open Water el 2 y el 3 de diciembre desde Cartagena. ¿Cómo reservamos y pagamos?
reply:
¡De una! Para reservar el Curso Open Water del 2 y 3 de diciembre desde Cartagena, háganlo directamente en este enlace. Allí eligen las fechas y 2 personas, y pagan en línea:

[Reservar Curso Open Water](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=es)

Como son clientes extranjeros, deben pagar el **100 % con tarjeta extranjera** y usar el **pasaporte** como documento de identificación. El **10 % de descuento online** se aplica automáticamente al reservar por la web.

El pago se registra al momento y el equipo lo concilia poco después para confirmar la reserva. Si falla el sistema o el pago online, el equipo les enviará un enlace para pagar por transferencia y se mantiene el descuento online.

Recuerden que el curso dura dos días y requiere alojarse al menos una noche en las islas; el alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel.

Quien no es colombiano ni residente en Colombia paga en dólares (USD) con tarjeta en la web; la tarifa es la misma, solo cambia la moneda.

msg: ¿Tenemos que dormir en las islas? ¿Qué incluye y qué no incluye cada plan, por ejemplo el hotel y las comidas?
reply:
Sí. Para completar tu Curso Referido, tienen que dormir al menos una noche en las islas: el primer día no se regresa a Cartagena. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel.

Desde Cartagena, el curso incluye la lancha de ida y vuelta, equipo, seguro, entrada al Parque Nacional, aporte eco-social y almuerzo del primer día. El almuerzo incluye agua durante el día y arroz con pollo o arroz con vegetales. No incluye hotel, transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas ni comida adicional.

Para tu novio, el plan de buceo certificado incluye equipo, seguro, entrada al Parque Nacional, lancha y almuerzo. También requiere alojamiento en las islas si elige un paquete de varios días. El plan de acompañante incluye lancha, almuerzo, seguro y entrada al Parque; no incluye alojamiento ni equipo de buceo o snorkel.

Para quien aún no ha elegido te recomiendo estas opciones. ¿Cuál le apetece más? 🐠

• *Snorkel* — Para disfrutar el arrecife desde la superficie, con máscara y aletas. Ideal en familia.
• *Ir de acompañante* — Viene en la lancha y disfruta el día con el grupo, sin meterse al agua.
